title: Physical stores and connections
summary: The already prepared hermetic B04 patch was integrated once after exact baseline/source hash checks and git apply --check. Current-source execution and a clean root without .agent-receipts each passed 14 tests with zero skips; both CLI paths regenerated the same pinned artifacts. All 8 original tests and 106 assertion ASTs are preserved. These are preparer execution observations awaiting independent acceptance, not a block-closure or live-store claim. Physical bindings, Qdrant model/version/dimensions and authenticated Redis metadata remain UNKNOWN or blocked.

proofs.detail: Prior synthesis turn parent pytest run recorded 2 passed, 6 failed due to (1) INPUT-MANIFEST.json string digest vs dict assumption, (2) QDRANT-METADATA.json 2-hashed-identity list vs named-collection dict assumption, and (3) false 20/20/4/10 collection registry counts vs real 11/18/11/21 (backend-rag) and 16/9 (graph-engine).

Pinned hermetic adapter and fixtures passed 14 meaningful tests on current source both with admitted receipts and without receipts; all 8 original tests and 106 assertion ASTs remain unchanged. Frozen source-derived artifacts are reproducible; projected identities and digest-only inputs do not claim original source bytes or fresh physical observations.

Verified D1 (EmbeddingCache._get_key omits model/provider/dims; 1536 vs 384 fallback config), D2 (cross-registry divergence on balizero_news and 4 asymmetric keys), D3 (174 pool factory candidates across 206 files), D4 (reindex_kbli_2025_final.py flat payload keys kode/kode_kbli/kode_kbli_2025 vs QdrantClient._FLAT_PAYLOAD_COLLECTIONS omitting kbli_2025_final), D5 (ingest_target_lint.py scope), and D6 (67 NOTEBOOK_CONTAINER_REFERENCE exclusions).

missing: Parent coordinator acceptance and its official source-bound verification receipt, then a fresh independent final gate under the owner's recorded Claude-availability exception. The committed head is bound externally by the parent; head_sha remains PENDING_DUX_COMMIT.
Qdrant embedding model and version, live dimensions, producer/consumer compatibility and deployed endpoint/principal/store bindings remain UNKNOWN until actually measured under existing authority.

U1: Live unhashed Qdrant collection inventory, vector dimensions, distance metrics, point counts, and payload key schemas behind the 2 hashed local identities in QDRANT-METADATA.json and any Qdrant Cloud deployment.
U2: Live Qdrant access principal (`access_principal: UNOBSERVED`) and authentication posture.
U3/U7: Unhashed target PostgreSQL deployment identity (`PG_TARGET_DEPLOYMENT_HASHED_IDENTITY`, `sha8-2bb691c3`).
U4: Live PostgreSQL `max_connections`, `PgBouncer` pooling mode, and per-role connection limits.
U5/U8: Authenticated Redis `INFO` / `ACL WHOAMI` / keyspace metadata on Pro and Mini (currently `AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED`).
U6/U10: Live SQLite/DuckDB/RocksDB/filesystem store file sizes, WAL modes, and lock states across hosts.
U9: Resolution of 3,647 `BLOCKED_DISCOVERY` and 284 `BLOCKED_RUNTIME_CONTRACT` rows in `consumer-matrix.csv`.

prior_synthesis_parent_run.notes: Failed in prior synthesis turn due to ungrounded INPUT-MANIFEST.json, QDRANT-METADATA.json, and collection_registry.py schema/count assumptions. Historical receipt retained; it is not the result of the current hermetic candidate.

correction_candidate.notes: The prior prepared correction is historical. Its baseline has 8 test methods, including the R2 regression test, established from the pinned original AST. A later isolated receipt recorded 8 passed. Current 14-test candidate execution is recorded separately below.

historical_isolated_regeneration.notes: Historical source pins differ from the integrated hermetic candidate; output artifact pins are reproduced by current execution.

current_clean_checkout.notes: Current candidate and fixtures in a clean temporary root without .agent-receipts; CLI exit 0 and exact artifact parity.
